input.goal: Pipeline stages in the system sometimes freeze, and only a human spots it. Teach the system to catch a frozen stage by itself and open an item for it.

provenance.note: harness-scenario conversion: the entry's arguments at a recorded call in a hermetic walk replay, expect = the verdict that call returned; the goal or answer text is a class paraphrase; surface variant B (anti-overfitting: same mechanism and expected verdict as the original, different surface text)
